driver_change: Persistent asynchronous Tokio UDS clients replace frozen Python threads/socket.makefile; production changes remain separately identified
existing_python_failures: Retained and valid; native results are an additional control and do not replace them
candidate: Explicit --binary and optional --source-manifest; record actual running executable hash
transport: Persistent AF_UNIX NDJSON JSON-RPC 2.0 with per-request tokens
http: Off for native baseline and native candidate; differs from frozen Python's idle HTTP listener
same_inbox: C enrolled senders plus one additional recipient identity
distributed_inboxes: C enrolled identities self-send, each with an independent persistent receiver connection
warmup_completion: Verify and fully acknowledge all warmups before measurement
scheduling: Ready barrier and release barrier; closed loop; no client credits or pacing
rate_denominator: Wall time from release through final successful receipt for sends admitted before deadline
rate_numerator: All successful measured-window receipts including completions after deadline; invalid qualification if any error

receiver_drain.connections: Independent persistent receiver RPC connection per destination inbox
receiver_drain.operation: Repeated wait_message(timeout_s=0), validate batch, ack cursor until empty

targets_declared_before_measurement.application: Each topology/concurrency independently; aggregate fails on any target miss, error or correctness failure

quantiles: Nearest rank p50/p95/p99 client call latency, excluding warmups
error_policy: Preserve successful receipts, deliveries, cursor RPCs, errors and raw root; terminate/reap owned child; continue all independent profiles; invalidate failed phases
disk_validation: After child exit, read-only LogFile<Envelope>::read_segments plus hash_record; no repair/open; exact receipt/delivery/record/sequence/identity/body/ack-head checks
provenance: Record host/source/binary/driver/frozen-helper/method hashes before and after; verify actual /proc child executable; baseline pins original manifest
resource_accounting: Per-window /proc driver/daemon CPU ticks, faults, RSS and optional I/O counters; retain permission/read failures
credentials: Never persist tokens or launch keys; redact JSON and scan every retained regular-file byte
diagnostic_filters: --profiles and --concurrencies; filtered run cannot pass full eight-profile qualification
limitations: One host/filesystem and one 10-second sample per condition, no confidence intervals
New driver/runtime and HTTP-off setting require matched native baseline/candidate comparison
Previous Python failures remain valid and visible
One outstanding sender at C=1 cannot supply batching overlap
Closed loops do not establish an independently paced arrival-rate ceiling
Readback verifies retained records, not power-loss durability
